notes.title: Overhaul Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953008/752e62057e1d8e859718becf5ee611dece19c3c1.png[/img]

Naxia is a game in active development. 

This means that we are constantly working on this game while improving both the game and ourselves as game developers, based on the feedback that we receive from our community.

Needless to say, the process is challenging, and yet, we are eager to tackle this challenge and are striving to make the best possible game.

One aspect of this challenge that we haven't yet been able to overcome, is to continuously deliver meaningful changes and improvements to the game. 

To reach and overcome this challenge, we have shifted our approach to the development and are treating The current version of Naxia as a pre-production version of the game!

While our top priority at this moment is to refactor the project, to be able to deliver monthly updates, we can't give an accurate estimate on when we can present a roadmap and release updates based on it.

[h3]For this reason, we decided to release [u]the current updated version of the game as a Free To Try prologue[/u].[/h3]

[h3][u]We have to emphasize that this prologue is currently identical to the paid version of the game and while by purchasing this game, you will receive the same version, you will receive all of our future content updates and will support us to reach our vision of Naxia[/u].[/h3]

In the current updated version of the game, we have changed our approach to combat. Previously, Ajira's attacks were stiff, had a small hitbox and her mobility was limited. This was mostly because we had focused on Ajira's skills, abilities, and her "Rage Form" to engage in combat. 

During our playtests and from the feed-backs we received from the community, we realized that Our current control scheme, Where you can't use your mouse pointer to move the character like traditional isometric ARPGs And you can only use your mouse pointer to aim your skills and attacks, Ajira's attacks should be reworked to feel more fluid and responsive. Furthermore, we realized that we wanted to sell the idea that "[b]Ajira is an agile and deadly Rouge![/b]".

For These reasons, we decided to focus on one weapon (her deadly daggers) and try to make the best combat experience using them. By doing so, we had to redesign our enemies and skills to better suit the combat experience that we were trying to design.

While we are satisfied with the results that we have achieved, we had to move some of our systems (skill tree, Quests, etc.) to in-development status to be able to solely focus on the combat changes.

tl;dr
[list]
[*]New Combat Systems
[list]
[*]Ajira attacks are wider and faster
[*]her mobility is vastly improved
[*]Players can now perform animation canceling mid-combo to use skills or dashes
[*]Ajira can Execute Enemies by dashing toward them
[/list]
[*]New Skills, designed for the new combat system
[list]
[*]Stab
[*]Cloak and dagger
[*]Golden Star
[/list]
[*]Redesigned enemies for the new Combat System
[list]
[*]Melee and Range Skeletons
[list]
[*]Elite Melee Skeletons
[/list]
[*]Shrieker
[*]Beckoner
[/list]
[*]New Boss, Mir-Baba

[*]New Tileset, Hadhir Forest

[*]New Hub Area, Hadhir Village

[*]Order System
[list]
[*]Replayable quests
[/list]
[/list]

For other information and to talk about the game Join Us on [url=discord.gg/GZ3HmXS]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Localization
notes.content:
Hi [b]Naxia Family[/b],

We are so happy to announce that two of our amazing community members translated Naxia to the following languages.  
 
- [b]Turkish [/b]by dear Çağla GURBET and Plus Localization Team
- [b]Polish [/b]by dear Krzysztof Gmyr. 
 
In the beginning, let us thank the [b]Naxia family[/b] whom without their help we couldn’t make it through. 
For one more time, we would like to ask our community members to help us in translating Naxia to their native language, to make it accessible for more players from all around the globe.  
So if you're interested, please do not hesitate to contact us via E-mail: support@naxiathegame.com. One of us will get back to you as soon as possible. 

We are proud to let you guys know that translating Naxia to Hungarian, Greek and Brazilian Portuguese is in progress and will be available for everyone in the near future. 

Although with being in the early stages of localization we are so likely to face some problems and flaws, we are putting our best effort to make our way to the perfect point and be as globally accessible as possible. 
We are one hundred percent positive that we can overcome each and every challenge with your constant support.  

[u]Note:[/u] In case you face any display or formatting issues while playing, you may press F12 to take a screenshot and share the bug reports with us in discord or via email. We are also open and eager for any kind of general feedback about the content of Naxia itself. Share your ideas with us. Hopefully, they will make a good change in the game.

tags.feature: - [b]Turkish [/b]by dear Çağla GURBET and Plus Localization Team

notes.title: Localization
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that we've started translating Naxia into five additional languages with the help of our community, including:

[list]
[*]Hungarian
[*]Turkish
[*]Italian
[*]Russian
[*]Polish
[/list]

As we are still in early access, localizing is in its early stages, which means the translations' quality may not always be perfect. Although the process of perfecting it may take time, we are determined to make Naxia accessible to as many players globally as possible!

We will likely face many challenges along the way, which we will successfully overcome with your support.

We ask our community members to try out the game in the existing German, Arabic, and other available languages and send us any feedback.

As an Indie game studio, we have decided to ask for support from the people most interested in localizing and translating the game, our community!  Help us share the story of Naxia in your native language. Your help is so valuable to us, and we deeply appreciate it.

So if you're interested, please contact us via e-mail: support@naxiathegame.com and one of our team members will get back to you as soon as possible.

Note: In case you face any display or formatting issues while playing, you may press F12 to take a screenshot and share the bug reports with us in [url=discord.gg/GZ3HmXS]discord [/url] or via email. We are also open to any general feedback about the content of Naxia itself. Share your thoughts and ideas with us - they just might make it into the game!

notes.title: Development Roadmap Naxia update 2
notes.content:
Since our last update, we have been hard at work on our next major update scheduled for Q1 2021, and we are eager to share some of the details with you. Before diving in, we want to thank you for your patience and continuing support!

In the previous update, we focused on the character sheet, dynamic loot table, weapon switching, and procedural dungeons but we aren't satisfied just yet and will continue tweaking those features in the coming months, as well as shift our focus onto some of our core mechanics:
 
[olist]
[*][b]Ajira’s Movement[/b]: Ajira is an assassin rogue and we wanted the players to feel this while playing as her, so we overhauled her movement to make controlling her feel faster and more responsive. This naturally makes traveling and exploring the world of Naxia much more enjoyable.

[*][b]Weapon Art[/b]: we wanted every weapon to feel unique to use. For this update, each weapon will have its own new combo sets. We are working on making these combo sets fluid and smooth to ultimately give the player more control when engaging enemies. These combo sets are hand-crafted to be different on a mechanical level so you can incorporate them into a variety of playstyles. Combine this with our dynamic loot system and every build will feel like a new experience.

[*][b]Enemies[/b]: Smarter, more dangerous enemies. Designed to be a threat alone as well as in groups. We are giving them a better understanding of the space and surroundings in which combat is taking place, creating interesting group encounters which force the player to respond differently to varying combinations of enemies.

[*][b]Boss Fights[/b]: We are working on more advanced behaviors for bosses. Giving them further control and making them more responsive to Ajira’s attacks and tactics, challenging the player to identify and exploit their weaknesses.

[*][b]Dungeons[/b]: More interesting layouts, including traps, hazards, and other surprises. 

[*][b]Tighter Battlefields[/b]:  Beware! Our new layouts are less spacious, watch your step as getting cornered by enemy groups can be lethal. Thankfully, Ajira’s faster control that is more responsive will allow players to position her on the battlefield to evade incoming attacks as well as take advantage of open opportunities to strike hard and deadly.

[*][b]Characters[/b]:  We added new NPCs and shopkeepers with new armors and weapons to buy and acquire via quests.
[/olist]
As always, we are looking forward to your feedback and feel free to reach out with any questions. Your feedback has helped us a lot in designing the previous update. Thanks for your effort and support in building [b]Naxia[/b].
 
For other information and to talk about the game please Join Us on Discord: discord.gg/GZ3HmXS
